name: obsidian-tablebase
description: Turn standard Markdown tables into interactive Notion-like databases: Kanban board view, multi-select tags, date pickers, calculations, and advanced filters

scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p dist/tablebase && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css dist/tablebase/ && cd dist && zip -r tablebase.zip tablebase && cd ..

author: Aleksei Che
